funds_data.description: The index is a modified market-capitalization weighted index that is composed of 200 global ex-U.S. large-capitalization and mid-capitalization companies with the highest composite scores based on two fundamental factors, growth and quality, which are equally weighted. The index is based on a rules-based methodology overseen and implemented by the WisdomTree Quality Growth Index Committee. The fund is non-diversified.
